scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@fortisim/engine && npm run build --workspace=@fortisim/backend && npm run build --workspace=@fortisim/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@fortisim/engine && npm test --workspace=@fortisim/engine && npm run build --workspace=@fortisim/backend && npm test --workspace=@fortisim/backend && npm test --workspace=@fortisim/frontend
scripts.backend:dev: npm run build --workspace=@fortisim/engine && npm run dev --workspace=@fortisim/backend
scripts.frontend:dev: npm run build --workspace=@fortisim/engine && npm run dev --workspace=@fortisim/frontend
scripts.admin:create: npm run build --workspace=@fortisim/engine && npm run build --workspace=@fortisim/backend && node scripts/create-admin.cjs
